name: A I Superlink
summary: Sydney dialup ISP (A I Superlink Pty Ltd); gone by ~2002 (A.I. SUPERLINK PTY LTD, ACN 076 955 676).

events.details: Gone (last ISP-era capture Mar 2000). Last verifiable live ISP page is mid-2000; both cur (2002) and prop (2001) sit slightly beyond the record, so 2000 is the best-supported year. last live ISP homepage Mar-Jun 2000; no captures 2001-2015, domain later re-registered.

refs.label: Live retail ISP homepage; probes for 2001, 2003 and 2006 all resolve to this Mar 2000 capture, i.e. no later captures exist
Live check 29 Sep 2026: domain now serves an unrelated college site — the ISP is long gone
